title: Dariifal tan xongolo
intro: Atu sidiica farmoytit qado astooti luk temeete magaalal solta, takkay immay ummatta ken tusuuleh, dumaahi gitat xakabuh tan. Magaalak baxsale exxak, inki num, ufuy ruubo kee margaqa, foocal nummat yaabam faxximta. miyyaay ta roociy ummaanim qawwalaylah addat culse sinni farmo hinna?
clues: Anu qado astooti luk farmoytit hirigteh tan ummattah fanat mannoowak suge, takkay immay oson kaxxiinitak wonnah yuduureenih.
Anu farmoytit seeco obbe wak magaalak allal arduk emeete.
Anu inni ummattah axcem yi ummatta kataya farmoytit kataya. koo essere waa mara kattaata, oson gitah miraacisen.'
Anu farmoytit hinniyo, takkay immay farmoytit elle aaminem kee yi ummatta tonnah akah abtannah kassiise.
Yi ummatta yi fayuh tusuuleh, extremist kinniimil yoo malkisse.
Oson yoo qidaanah yalli jannat cul iyyeeh, yi ummatta yoh geyteh tan cabsu kee konnabna taaxigem qaagita.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Magaala fan ruuben sidiica farmoytak tiyak teeni .
